description: Department of Trade and Investment Policy - Special Commodity Levy for the Potatoes and B'onions and rescinded with effat from January 01, 2022
reasoning: This gazette content involves the imposition of a Special Commodity Levy under the Special Commodity Levy Act, No. 48 of 2007. It constitutes a regulatory order that modifies existing regulations (rescinding previous gazette notifications) and establishes new levy rates for specific commodities. This falls squarely under Legal/Regulatory matters (Type 5) as it deals with statutory instruments, regulatory frameworks, and compliance requirements rather than government personnel changes, organizational structure, or other specialized categories.
